summary.text: Omar Fateh is a Democratic state senator who represents District 62 and is the only candidate on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for the seat.
He chairs the Senate Higher Education Finance and Policy Committee and was a candidate for Mayor of Minneapolis in 2025.

paragraphs.text: Fateh was born in Washington, D.C., and lives in Minneapolis, Minnesota. He graduated from Falls Church High School and earned bachelor's and master's degrees in public administration from George Mason University.
His career experience includes working as a campaign finance analyst for the Federal Election Commission and as an academic advisor with Northern Virginia Community College.
Fateh assumed office in the Minnesota State Senate on January 5, 2021, succeeding Jeff Hayden.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a state senator, husband, renter, son of Somali immigrants and long-time advocate for working people who was running for Mayor of Minneapolis in 2025.
Ballotpedia reports that the 2025 Minneapolis mayoral election was won by Jacob Frey, and Fateh remained in the Senate.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are Higher Education Finance and Policy, which he chairs, Human Services, where he is vice chair, and Local Government.
